author: jessica
source: his 2026-10-15 06:33: "Talk to someone, there cargo was taken, get it back from dungeon and deliver ig"
_note: THE HIJACKED RUN: you meet a hauler first, raiders took her cargo into a dungeon, you take it back and FINISH HER
RUN, delivering it where it was going rather than back to her. That is his Delve shape exactly: an unfinished job
somebody else started (2026-09-23). His idea; words Jessica's.
A PURE VARIANT by his rule (prove the verbs, then vary cheaply): talk first is 14a's, recover off the dungeon boss
is 11a's, the hand-over at the drop is 15a's (a footlocker until 2026-10-23), three places is 08a's. If the lint passes, nothing here is new machinery.
Order: talk at the main place (quiet, peopled by her), the dungeon second, the drop third. Three disjoint pools as
08a, so no two beats can share a site.
Pay: reward on the hand-over, the single ending. 'hard' is a placeholder; the tier is his.

place._themes: THREE DISJOINT POOLS, as 08a: her out in the wild by her landed ship (natural, not a quiet site), the raiders at a built hostile site (no natural, no quiet), the drop at a quiet built site, where Dace and six others are waiting. Quiet AND natural is an empty pool (measured 2026-10-15), so the wild end is hers.

prose.name: Recovery: Hijacked Filters on <Planet>
prose.briefing: A hauler set down near the <Place> was jumped on her run. The raiders left her the ship and took the cargo, a crate of water filters somebody is waiting for.

beats.objective: Talk to the hauler at the <Place>
beats.journal: Raiders jumped a hauler and took her cargo, a crate of water filters, to the <SecondPlace>. I need to get the filters back and finish her run to the <ThirdPlace>.

person.name: Rhea Dunmore
hellos: Easy. I've had enough visitors this week.

greeting: You're not one of them, are you? Then you can help, if you want to.

reply: Water filters, one crate. Somebody's been waiting a week to drink without boiling it first. Don't bring it back to me. Take it where it was going.
Four of them. Very polite until they weren't. They took the crate and left me the ship, which I suppose was kind of them.
I did. Someone's going to look into it next month. The filters were due last week.
Tall. A scar through one eyebrow. Laughed at his own jokes. If he's worth something to you, take that as well. I won't miss him.

beats._talk: Exchange 0 closes the talk and sets the recover's stage. Exchange 3 is a [Bounty Hunter] line (his 2026-10-14 RP feature): only a hunter asks for a description. Voiced lines: no names, no places, no factions, no currency.

beats.objective: Recover the filter crate from the <SecondPlace>
beats.journal: I took the crate of water filters back from the raiders' leader at the <SecondPlace>. Now I need to finish the run to the <ThirdPlace>.

beats.objective: Deliver the water filters to the <ThirdPlace>
beats.journal: A hauler was jumped on her run and lost a crate of water filters to raiders at the <SecondPlace>. I got them back and finished the run to the <ThirdPlace>, where they had been boiling every drop for a week.

person.name: Dace Morrow
hellos: If you're selling, we're not buying. Unless it's filters.

greeting: Is that a filter crate? Tell me that's a filter crate. We've been boiling every drop for a week.

exchanges.prompt: It's your filters. The hauler sent them on.
reply: She's all right? I'll have these in by tonight. First glass I don't have to wait for, I'm raising it to her.
The old ones clogged. You can drink what comes out, if you boil it first and don't look at it.
Me and six others. Six others who've each told me how to fix the pump.

beats._talk: Was a deliver into a footlocker until 2026-10-23, his play: "last delivery POI feels weak. No voice and no people just a small box". Now the 15a shape: a person waiting at the drop, and exchange 0 is the hand-over (ends the conversation, takes the Crate of Water Filters, sets stage 100, which pays 'reward'). Three exchanges, not four (the talk-count monoculture, 20261019-105054). Voice 'Killian', calm, irish, used twice; his ear decides. Voiced lines: no names, no places, no factions, no currency.

broadcast: I've been jumped. I'm fine, the ship's fine. The cargo isn't, and somebody's waiting on it.
_speech: Her voice on the radio first, then in person. Voice is 05a's (wCizWKvnaS3LOIUwHo98), used once so far, so this is not Isla; his ear decides. No names, no places, no currency.
